root_cause.text: The AMD display backlight setup code in `setup_backlight_device()` dereferenced `caps->ext_caps` unconditionally, but LVDS connectors can have `ext_caps == NULL` because they do not provide extended backlight capabilities, leading to a null-pointer dereference when checking the OLED bit.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (!caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)` to `if (caps->ext_caps && !caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0)`, and the commit message explicitly states “LVDS connectors don't have extended backlight caps so check if the pointer is valid before accessing it.”

intent_record.what: The conditional before attaching the ABM property was changed from checking only `!caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0` to first verifying `caps->ext_caps` is non-NULL with `caps->ext_caps && !caps->ext_caps->bits.oled && amdgpu_dm_abm_level < 0`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the code now avoids dereferencing `caps->ext_caps` when it is NULL, preventing a potential null-pointer crash while deciding whether to expose the ABM property.

grouping_result.intent: Add a null check for `ext_caps` before using it to decide whether to attach the ABM property.

candidates.rationale: This statement dereferences caps->ext_caps without checking for NULL. On LVDS connectors ext_caps can be NULL, so evaluating caps->ext_caps->bits.oled triggers a null-pointer dereference.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition dereferences caps->ext_caps without first checking whether it is NULL. For LVDS connectors, ext_caps may be absent, so evaluating caps->ext_caps->bits.oled can trigger a null-pointer dereference in setup_backlight_device().
